title: Pink Paper Towel Holder, 15.5-Inch Wall Mount Powder Coated Iron, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Pink, wall mounted paper towel holder, 15.5 in long x 3 in high x 4 in projection, powder coated iron pipe-style design for kitchen paper towel storage and dispensing, which brings playful, modern energy to kitchen design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. Industrial modern look inspired by pipe fittings; works with modern or traditional decor. Wall mount installation saves counter space and mounts firmly with color coordinating screws (#8 x 1 1/4) and included installation hardware. Protected using highly durable powder coat for a clean, decorative finish and corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Contemporary design with rustic influences. Limited lifetime warranty. Part of the Pipeline collection for matching pipeline, pipe-style accessories and loft-style fixtures — Allied Brass Pipeline.
